extraction.Name: Hiram Good Chief
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Sold to O. R. Spinning for $3000
extraction.Buyer: O. R. Spinning; $3000 was a fair price at that time. Owed Mr. Spinning about $90.00
extraction.Occupation/Income: No inherited land. Shares in Pawnee annuity.
extraction.NOTES: Date and manner of delivery of patent: Dec. 5, 1917, Agency office. Patent receipted: yes. No property and no money accumulated. Fair health. Wife and three children dependent on him. It seems that the Competency Commission made a mistake in issuing this allottee a patent, as he sold the land for a small price. Present land is producing oil. Document notarized November 26, 1928, Pawnee County, Oklahoma.
